statement: The node watches the disputes its peer starts against it and counters with the newest co-signed proof of the epoch while the dispute is open, restating the counter at every frame of the Entity until the chain says the dispute is over, so that one counter lands inside the floor window (60 + 60 s on testnet). With no co-signed proof of the epoch there is nothing to counter with: the implicit proof is the best state there is. A dispute the node started itself, or one of another epoch, is not countered.

killers.name: R-DISPUTE-WATCH every frame of the Entity restates the counter while the dispute is open
R-DISPUTE-WATCH the dispute being over, or the epoch moving on, ends it
R-DISPUTE-WATCH a dispute Alice started, or one of another epoch, is not the Entity's to counter
R-DISPUTE-WATCH a Host that restarts keeps the dispute and is asked to counter again
